mapper.insert: insert into sdsorder.u_f_docdetail_${tableSuffix}( shop_code, detailcode, doccode, lineno, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, qty, saleprice, saleamount, costprice, costamount, batchcode, orderdetailcode, remark ) values( #{shopCode}, #{detailCode}, #{docCode}, #{lineNo}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, #{qualityFlag}, #{onhandFlag}, #{qty}, #{salePrice}, #{saleAmount}, #{costPrice}, #{costAmount}, #{batchCode}, #{orderDetailCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark} )

insert into sdsorder.u_f_docdetail_${tableSuffix}( shop_code, detailcode, doccode, lineno, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, qty, saleprice, saleamount, costprice, costamount, batchcode, orderdetailcode, remark ) values
( #{item.shopCode}, #{item.detailCode}, #{item.docCode}, #{item.lineNo}, #{item.goodsCode}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.wareCode}, #{item.wareName}, #{item.qualityFlag}, #{item.onhandFlag}, #{item.qty}, #{item.salePrice}, #{item.saleAmount}, #{item.costPrice}, #{item.costAmount}, #{item.batchCode}, #{item.orderDetailCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.remark} )
mapper.select: select substring(table_name, length('u_f_docmain_') + 1) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'sdsorder' and table_name like 'u_f_docmain_%'

select d.goodscode as goodsCode, max(d.goodsname) as goodsName, max(d.spec) as spec, max(d.unit) as unit, d.warecode as warehouseCode, max(d.warename) as warehouseName, sum(d.qty) as shippedQty, sum(coalesce(d.costamount, 0)) as costAmount from sdsorder.u_f_docdetail_${tableSuffix} d join sdsorder.u_f_docmain_${tableSuffix} m on m.shop_code = d.shop_code and m.doccode = d.doccode where m.shop_code = #{shopCode} and m.doctype = 'CK' and m.sourcedoctype = 'XSFH' and m.confirmstate = '已审核' and m.sourcedoccode in #{code} group by d.goodscode, d.warecode

select d.goodscode as goodsCode, d.warecode as warehouseCode, sum(d.qty) as returnedQty from sdsorder.u_f_docdetail_${tableSuffix} d join sdsorder.u_f_docmain_${tableSuffix} m on m.shop_code = d.shop_code and m.doccode = d.doccode where m.shop_code = #{shopCode} and m.doctype = 'XSTHRK' and m.sourcedoccode = #{orderCode} and m.confirmstate in ('待审核', '已审核') group by d.goodscode, d.warecode
